title: In conversation with Sergey Stavisky
title_zh: 与谢尔盖·斯塔夫斯基的对话
abstract: As part of our special issue on Neurotechnology, we spoke with Sergey Stavisky, Associate Professor at the University of California, Davis, about the breakthroughs that have transformed speech neuroprostheses from proof-of-concept demonstrations into practical communication systems. He reflects on the scientific surprises, engineering challenges and ethical questions that are shaping the future of neural interfaces.
abstract_zh: 作为我们神经技术专题的一部分，我们与加州大学戴维斯分校的谢尔盖·斯塔夫斯基副教授交谈，探讨那些将语言神经假体从概念验证转变为实际交流系统的突破。他回顾了塑造神经接口未来的科学惊喜、工程挑战和伦理问题。
